articles.title: Still in Early Innings of AI Adoption: PSP’s Momei Qu
articles.summary: Momei Qu, Managing Director and Head of Venture at PSP Growth, says Anthropic is in a period of price discovery as public-market investors work out how to value a frontier AI company. Compared with SaaS predecessors, Anthropic may offer faster growth and a larger addressable market, but investors are weighing substantial capital expenditure, uncertain long-term margins and questions about its competitive moat. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
